description: Instrument and ingestion metadata only; no catalog item promises an automatic market feed or bundled historical prices.
history_policy: Analysis may begin in 1986 only where each selected input has supplied, valid overlapping history. Coverage never creates unavailable ENAG, ETF, crypto, or other observations.

series.name: BIST 100
series.notes: Use an audited TRY index series; specify price or total-return variant. Historical divisor changes and official continuity matter.

series.name: BIST 30
series.notes: Use an audited TRY index series; specify price or total-return variant. Historical divisor changes and official continuity matter.

series.name: BIST Banks
series.notes: Use an audited TRY index series; specify price or total-return variant. Historical divisor changes and official continuity matter.

series.name: Turkish Airlines
series.notes: Use a consistently split/corporate-action adjusted series. A closing price excludes reinvested dividends; use a wealth series for total return.

series.name: Tüpraş
series.notes: Use a consistently split/corporate-action adjusted series. A closing price excludes reinvested dividends; use a wealth series for total return.

series.name: Aselsan
series.notes: Use a consistently split/corporate-action adjusted series. A closing price excludes reinvested dividends; use a wealth series for total return.

series.name: Türkiye İş Bankası C
series.notes: Use a consistently split/corporate-action adjusted series. A closing price excludes reinvested dividends; use a wealth series for total return.

series.name: TÜİK consumer price index
series.ingestion: manual CSV / selected EVDS / OECD query
series.notes: Use official index levels with base-series continuity and release dates; do not divide an asset by annual inflation percentages.

series.name: ENAG E-CPI linked levels
series.notes: Import published monthly changes as ENAG_MOM and chain only consecutive observed months; never synthesize 1986 ENAG history. Preserve publication evidence.

series.name: ENAG E-CPI monthly changes
series.notes: Published MoM percentages in value; retain available_date, published_yoy and source_url. Not annual percentages.

series.name: US all items CPI
series.notes: Select CPIAUCSL (seasonally adjusted) or CPIAUCNS (not seasonally adjusted) consciously. Current FRED vintage is not a release-date dataset.

series.name: USD/TRY
series.notes: Quote direction is TRY per one USD; divide TRY assets by this series to obtain USD amounts. Specify buying/selling and observation time.

series.name: EUR/TRY
series.notes: Quote direction is TRY per one EUR; buying/selling spreads and timestamp selection matter.

series.name: CHF/TRY
series.notes: Use TRY per CHF for conversion into CHF. A CHF currency quote alone is not Swiss CPI.

series.name: Gold gram TRY
series.notes: Local retail premiums/spreads can differ from spot gold converted using FX; document which price is supplied.

series.name: Gold troy ounce USD
series.notes: Spot/futures/ETF series are different instruments. One troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams; conversion alone does not add local premiums.

series.name: Silver troy ounce USD
series.notes: Select a consistent quote, currency and spot/futures contract basis.

series.name: S&P 500
series.notes: Catalog describes a price index; reinvested dividends require the appropriate total-return source. Provider licenses and historical coverage vary.

series.name: Nasdaq 100
series.notes: Catalog describes a price index; reinvested dividends require the appropriate total-return source. Provider licenses and historical coverage vary.

series.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
series.notes: Catalog describes a price index; reinvested dividends require the appropriate total-return source. Provider licenses and historical coverage vary.

series.name: Bitcoin USD
series.notes: Choose venue, daily close timezone and stablecoin-versus-fiat quote deliberately. History predates neither the asset nor the chosen venue.

series.name: Ether USD
series.notes: Choose venue, daily close timezone and stablecoin-versus-fiat quote deliberately. History predates neither the asset nor the chosen venue.

series.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
series.notes: Split-only close and dividend-adjusted wealth are different. Label whether dividends/distributions are reinvested; no 1986 ETF history is invented.

series.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
series.notes: Split-only close and dividend-adjusted wealth are different. Label whether dividends/distributions are reinvested; no 1986 ETF history is invented.

series.name: User-selected TEFAS fund
series.notes: Replace generic identifier with the actual fund code. Include management-fee treatment, fund inception, unit price and corporate changes.

series.name: TRY deposit cumulative wealth
series.notes: Import cumulative after-tax wealth or construct it using explicit annual rate, day-count, compounding, maturity and tax rules. Annual deposit rates are not price levels.

series.name: Turkish bond cumulative wealth
series.notes: Yield alone is not total return. Include coupon reinvestment, duration, clean/dirty price, fees/taxes, FX for foreign-currency bonds and contractual dates.

series.name: Türkiye housing price index
series.notes: Use TCMB series and regional/quality adjustment definition with release dates. A housing index excludes rent, transaction costs and individual-property differences.
